description: Formal invariant specification for Velo HTLC Escrow smart contract state machine and accounting.

invariants.name: Conservation of Value
invariants.description: Total balance across buyer, seller, admin, and escrow contract must remain strictly conserved. Deposited funds must equal held funds plus net payouts.

invariants.name: State Machine Exclusivity & Monotonicity
invariants.description: Terminal states (Released, Refunded) cannot transition to any other state. Valid transitions are strictly Locked -> {Disputed, Released, Refunded} and Disputed -> {Released, Refunded}.
invariants.expression: terminal(Released) && terminal(Refunded) && valid_transitions(Locked -> [Disputed, Released, Refunded], Disputed -> [Released, Refunded])

invariants.name: Timeout Monotonicity
invariants.description: Refund operations must fail with TimeoutNotReached when current_ledger < timeout_ledger. Dispute operations must fail with TimeoutReached when current_ledger >= timeout_ledger.
invariants.expression: ledger < timeout_ledger => refund() == Err(TimeoutNotReached) && ledger >= timeout_ledger => dispute() == Err(TimeoutReached)

invariants.name: Secret Hash Correctness
invariants.description: Release operations must succeed if and only if sha256(secret) == secret_hash. Invalid preimages must be rejected with InvalidSecret.

invariants.name: Fee Math Conservation & Bounds
invariants.description: Platform fee basis points must be within [0, 10000]. Payout fee calculations must satisfy fee = (amount * fee_bps) / 10000 and fee + payout == amount with no overflow or lost dust.

invariants.name: Authorization & Governance Integrity
invariants.description: Privileged admin operations (resolve, pause, set_platform_fee) require valid admin auth or N-of-M multisig threshold. Unauthorized calls must fail.

invariants.name: Reserve Conservation & Circuit-Breaker Pause
invariants.description: The escrow contract's token balance must always equal the sum of amounts held by non-terminal trades (reserve conservation). Arming the circuit-breaker pause must take effect after PAUSE_DELAY_LEDGERS, reject new locks with ContractPaused, and never move existing reserves. Unpausing restores lock operation.
invariants.expression: balance(contract) == sum(amount: status in {Locked, Disputed}) && paused_effective => lock() == Err(ContractPaused) && paused_effective => sum_active_reserves_unchanged
